about.bio: With over 15 years of industry experience, Shadowstripe Consulting was founded on the principles of integrity, practicality, and clarity. We reject corporate clichés and 'thought leadership' fluff, focusing entirely on delivering concrete HR and risk management solutions for serious SMEs. Our goal is to provide reliable support that protects your business and empowers your workforce.
